% SCI-PTC v0.1 shared normative requirements -- owner-review draft r0.3.
\section{Normative requirements}
\label{sec:normative-requirements}

\subsection{Input identity, lineage, and state}

\PTCRequirement{001}{Admitted calibrated signal}{Rationale 1.1}{D001,D002}{SCI-CAL}{PTC shall accept as its primary numerical parent only an admitted sample-by-detector SCI-CAL $x$ product in top-of-atmosphere, point-source-equivalent mJy per fixed nominal beam, with explicit response state.}
\PTCRequirement{002}{Complete RTC lineage}{Rationale 1.1}{D001,D008}{SCI-RTC}{The admitted bundle shall retain conditioned-$x$ identity, raw-$r$ parent identity, exact time grid, and every causal RTC selector, segmentation, validity, response, uncertainty, replacement, and influence state.}
\PTCRequirement{003}{Upstream availability}{Rationale 1.1}{D003}{SCI-RTC,SCI-CAL}{An invalid or unavailable required RTC or CAL fact shall make the affected calibrated PTC product or claim unavailable; PTC shall not repair, approximate, or relabel it.}
\PTCRequirement{004}{Matrix shape}{Rationale 1.1}{D001}{SCI-CAL}{Every primary matrix shall declare samples on rows, detectors on columns, actual extents, flattening/storage order, and the bijection between positions and scientific identities.}
\PTCRequirement{005}{Time identity}{Rationale 1.1}{D001}{SCI-RTC}{Sample time shall carry declared scale, epoch, unit, actual timestamps, gaps, segment boundaries, and any cross-boundary support; nominal rate shall not replace actual time identity.}
\PTCRequirement{006}{Detector identity}{Rationale 1.1}{D011}{APT}{Detector joins shall use immutable occurrence/UID identity and exact APT binding; dense columns, file order, or local integers shall not be external identities.}
\PTCRequirement{007}{Within-array domain}{Rationale 3.2}{D011}{APT,SCI-CAL}{Every base fit shall be confined to one declared array. Cross-array modes shall be unavailable without separately authorized spectral, calibration, beam, source-color, and response authority.}
\PTCRequirement{008}{Requested operation}{Rationale 4.1}{D010,D012}{Owner policy}{The requested state shall identify estimator family, candidate ordering, conjunctive predicates, centering/scaling, gauge, grouping, support policy, refinement, source protection, coefficient families, response, covariance, simulation, and output roles; absence shall differ from an explicit value.}
\PTCRequirement{009}{One-way state lifecycle}{Rationale }{D004,D009}{None}{Requested, effective-policy, observation-resolved input, learned/fitted evidence, resolved selected model, applied/realized state, and published product state shall be immutable, one-way linked, and distinct as in Equation~\ref{eq:lifecycle}. A later stage shall not overwrite or reconstruct an earlier stage.}
\PTCRequirement{010}{Unit preservation limit}{Rationale 1.2}{D002,D014}{SCI-CAL}{Ordinary transformed $x$ shall retain the admitted CAL unit and calibration convention, but unit retention shall not be labeled preservation of point-source peak, absolute level, extended-source response, detector combinations, or beam shape.}

\subsection{Validity, causes, and support}

\PTCRequirement{011}{Cause is not action}{Rationale 2.1}{D007}{VAL}{Every flag shall remain a typed cause. No cause name alone shall imply zero-fill, universal rejection, zero coefficient, refit, or downstream ineligibility.}
\PTCRequirement{012}{Per-use support map}{Rationale 2.1}{D007}{VAL}{Each cause shall map independently and immutably into basis-fit, loading-fit, application, output, coefficient/QC, response, empirical, simulation, and downstream supports as in Equation~\ref{eq:cause-support}.}
\PTCRequirement{013}{Finite eligible arithmetic}{Rationale 2.1}{D007}{VAL}{Only eligible finite occurrences shall enter a fit, normalization, covariance estimate, convergence statistic, or coefficient statistic. Missing, non-finite, invalid, rejected, unavailable, and numeric zero shall remain distinct.}
\PTCRequirement{014}{No silent zero filling}{Rationale 2.1}{D007,D010}{None}{A missing or fit-excluded value shall not be replaced by numerical zero before PCA/SVD or another estimator unless exact equivalence to zero statistical influence is proved for the selected estimator.}
\PTCRequirement{015}{Fit-excluded apply-allowed state}{Rationale 2.1}{D007}{VAL}{The support model shall express an occurrence excluded from mode or loading learning but eligible for application and output, without treating that state as fit validity.}
\PTCRequirement{016}{Direct synthesized/replaced occurrences}{Rationale 2.1}{D007}{SCI-RTC,ALIGN}{Direct ALIGN-synthesized or RTC-replaced occurrences shall be excluded from the calibrated PTC science branch.}
\PTCRequirement{017}{Transitive influence}{Rationale 2.2}{D007}{SCI-RTC,VAL}{Noncenter causal influence shall be preserved and evaluated under PTC's declared use-specific support and response policy; compact over-approximation is permitted and under-approximation is not.}
\PTCRequirement{018}{Mask identity}{Rationale 2.2}{D004,D007}{AST,ALIGN}{Every mask shall declare polarity, use, parent, frame, unit, registration, support, boundary convention, and derivation state. One mask bit shall not silently govern every use.}

\subsection{Estimand, coordinates, and grouping}

\PTCRequirement{019}{Declared estimand}{Rationale 1.2}{D004,D014}{None}{Every realized operation shall identify the exact correlated-mode or supplied-template estimand, objective/loss, metric, parameterization, fit support, loading support, application support, acting space, and frozen-state application map.}
\PTCRequirement{020}{No physical-origin inference}{Rationale 1.2}{D004,D014}{None}{A fitted correlated component shall not be labeled atmosphere, electronics, calibration residual, detector noise, or sky solely because it is correlated.}
\PTCRequirement{021}{Removed subspace publication}{Rationale 1.2}{D014}{None}{Every transformed product shall publish the complete removed subspace or template family, group, metric, rank, support, fit order, degeneracy, and gauge-equivalence class.}
\PTCRequirement{022}{Additive reference and null space}{Rationale 1.3}{D014,D017}{None}{Every product shall publish additive-reference state, irrecoverable centering modes, complete declared null-space status, and astronomical modes known or permitted to be attenuated.}
\PTCRequirement{023}{Centering contract}{Rationale 3.1}{D017}{None}{Each centering operation shall declare axis, population, support, weights, location estimator, masks, boundaries, units, restoration rule, gauge, and resulting null space.}
\PTCRequirement{024}{Scaling contract}{Rationale 3.1}{D017}{None}{Each scaling operation shall declare axis, population, support, weights, scale estimator, nonzero/finite rule, units, inverse, gauge, and failure state; internal scaling shall be restored before ordinary output.}
\PTCRequirement{025}{Gauge-invariant claim}{Rationale 3.1}{D014,D015}{None}{Scientific claims shall attach to the fitted correlated signal and removed subspace, not to unpinned basis sign, reciprocal basis/loading scale, component order, or rotation inside a degenerate subspace.}
\PTCRequirement{026}{Estimator-family identity}{Rationale }{D010}{None}{The resolved selected model shall name the estimator family, its exact mathematical definition, and its distinct fit and application rules; robust common mode, fixed-template regression, masked/weighted PCA/SVD, frozen-component subtraction, and diagnostic-$r$ PCA shall not be conflated.}
\PTCRequirement{027}{Robust common-mode family}{Rationale }{D010}{None}{A common-mode family shall state the input coordinate, location estimator, aggregation weights and their unit/normalization, support, denominator rule, detector loading model, units, and robust-loss behavior; an aggregation weight shall not be labeled a fitted loading, and a median shall not be documented as an arithmetic mean.}
\PTCRequirement{028}{Fixed-template family}{Rationale 4.1}{D010}{None}{A fixed-template regression shall state template parent, unit, gauge, metric, generalized inverse, tolerance, fit support, loading support, application support, and exact treatment of rank deficiency.}
\PTCRequirement{029}{Masked/weighted PCA family}{Rationale }{D007,D010,Q002}{None}{A PCA/SVD family shall state matrix orientation, the space containing the removed basis, every frozen quantity, every coefficient recomputed linearly at application, exact temporal-left, detector-right, two-sided, detector/time-specific, or vectorized application map, centering/scaling, missing-data model, weights/noise metric, candidate construction, component order, rank, degeneracy/tie rule, generalized inverse/tolerance, fit support, and application support. Base-v0.1 application shall project through the frozen realized subspace and metric rather than subtract one frozen numerical reconstruction.}
\PTCRequirement{030}{Diagnostic-only conditioned $r$}{Rationale 4.2}{D008,Q001}{SCI-RTC}{Conditioned-$r$ PCA shall be available only with a separately authorized compatible parent and shall remain inert or advisory: it shall not alter calibrated-$x$ membership, subtraction, output, coefficients, or supply an $x$ subtraction basis.}
\PTCRequirement{031}{Hierarchical groups}{Rationale 3.2}{D011}{APT}{The realized model shall identify array-wide, network/electronics, and optional local/focal-plane components and the exact detectors, coordinates, and supports in each group.}
\PTCRequirement{032}{Joint or sequential order}{Rationale 3.2}{D011}{None}{Overlapping hierarchical components shall declare joint fitting or exact sequential order. Sequential residual fitting shall be one complete ordered estimator with cumulative removed subspace, response, covariance, and parentage.}
\PTCRequirement{033}{Data-derived grouping}{Rationale 3.2}{D011}{None}{A data-derived group shall record population, metric, candidate rule, cardinality controls, stability test, held-out or adjacent-segment status, selection uncertainty, and frozen application identity.}

\subsection{Mode selection and source protection}

\PTCRequirement{034}{Finite candidate set}{Rationale 4.3}{D012}{Owner policy}{Mode/component selection shall evaluate a finite declared candidate set after centering, scaling, grouping, supports, and noise metric are fixed.}
\PTCRequirement{035}{Conjunctive admission}{Rationale }{D012}{Owner policy}{The selected candidate shall be the least aggressive candidate for which every required residual-contamination, astronomical-transfer, conditioning, support, stability, and QC predicate passes. Each predicate shall retain its typed value, unit, uncertainty treatment, threshold, comparison polarity, pass/fail cause, and claim.}
\PTCRequirement{036}{No compensating score}{Rationale 4.3}{D012}{Owner policy}{Failure of any required selection predicate shall not be offset by improvement in another predicate or by a scalar aggregate score.}
\PTCRequirement{037}{Ordering and ties}{Rationale 4.3}{D012}{Owner policy}{Candidate ordering, least-aggressive relation, deterministic tie handling, and boundary comparison polarity shall be declared before selection.}
\PTCRequirement{038}{Nonnested candidates}{Rationale 4.3}{D012}{Owner policy}{Nonnested candidates shall be compared by their complete removed subspace and astronomical response rather than mode count alone.}
\PTCRequirement{039}{Empty admission set}{Rationale 4.3}{D012}{Owner policy}{If no candidate passes every required predicate, the requested transformed product shall be unavailable or rejected with cause; an aggressive fallback shall not be selected silently.}
\PTCRequirement{040}{No universal threshold}{Rationale 4.3}{D012}{None}{No universal mode count, variance fraction, eigengap, or singular-value threshold shall be treated as scientific authority outside its declared model and evidence.}
\PTCRequirement{041}{Source-mask limit}{Rationale 3.3}{D004,D014}{AST,ALIGN}{A source mask shall protect only its declared source model and registered support and shall not be represented as proof that unmasked compact emission, extended emission, or other sky modes survive.}

\subsection{Post-fit detector assessment and repetition}

\PTCRequirement{042}{Diagnostic definition}{Rationale 5.1}{D009}{Owner policy}{Every residual, loading, influence, stability, source-response, non-Gaussianity, transient, or $x/r$ diagnostic shall declare estimator, population or approved noise/signal reference, normalization, support, uncertainty, and policy role.}
\PTCRequirement{043}{Pathology discrimination}{Rationale 5.1}{D009}{Owner policy}{Post-fit assessment shall distinguish detector pathology from astronomical signal, source-model/mask failure, calibration state, focal-plane position, and expected detector-sensitivity variation.}
\PTCRequirement{044}{Owner-controlled thresholds}{Rationale 5.1}{D009}{Owner policy}{Numerical classification thresholds shall be explicit owner-controlled inputs. A missing threshold shall not be inferred from current data, code, or population behavior.}
\PTCRequirement{045}{Finite refinement}{Rationale 5.2}{D009}{None}{The fit-diagnose-classify-refit process shall be finite and shall record each support, diagnostic, class, refit decision, and emitted final state.}
\PTCRequirement{046}{Immutable-parent refit}{Rationale 5.2}{D009}{SCI-CAL}{Every fit-support-changing refinement shall refit one complete selected model from the same immutable admitted CAL parent and apply the final complete model once. A previously cleaned output shall not be the refit parent.}
\PTCRequirement{047}{Non-fit dispositions}{Rationale 5.2}{D007,D009}{VAL}{A postfit-output rejection, coefficient-only decision, or advisory diagnostic shall not retroactively change the fitted state.}
\PTCRequirement{048}{Refinement stopping state}{Rationale 5.2}{D009}{Owner policy}{Stop state shall distinguish stable support/subspace, no-new-threshold event, maximum refinements, oscillation, insufficient support, nonconvergence, exhaustion, and error; oscillation shall not be called convergence.}
\PTCRequirement{049}{Internal iteration identity}{Rationale 5.3}{D009}{None}{Internal numerical iteration shall record statistic, norm/support, tolerance and unit, minimum/maximum iterations, comparison polarity, empty/non-finite behavior, selected iterate, and converged/exhausted/error status.}
\PTCRequirement{050}{PTC pass identity}{Rationale 5.3}{D005,D009}{FRUIT}{A new PTC pass shall have an immutable new input parent and distinct realized identity; it shall not overwrite a previous pass.}
\PTCRequirement{051}{External recurrence boundary}{Rationale 5.3}{D004,D005}{FRUIT}{Model subtraction/add-back, map feedback, external recurrence, restart, and recurrence parentage shall remain FRUIT or another declared recurrence owner's authority.}

\subsection{Coefficients and uncertainty}

\PTCRequirement{052}{Coefficient taxonomy}{Rationale 6.1}{D015}{SCI-MAP}{Fitted loadings, centering/scaling parameters, diagnostic coefficients, and analysis/gridding coefficients shall be distinct typed families. Only an explicitly named analysis/gridding family may be MAP-facing.}
\PTCRequirement{053}{Fitted-loading semantics}{Rationale 6.1}{D015}{None}{A fitted loading shall declare basis/template identity, gauge, unit, group, fit support, lifecycle, and numerical use and shall prohibit weight, precision, significance, sensitivity, or independent-noise interpretation.}
\PTCRequirement{054}{Analysis/gridding coefficient}{Rationale }{D015}{SCI-MAP}{Each analysis/gridding family shall declare detector or detector-time index family, exact statistic/factors, their domains, unit, normalization operator, normalization domain, selected support, lifecycle, permitted consumers, numerical use, and prohibited interpretations.}
\PTCRequirement{055}{Coefficient re-estimation}{Rationale 6.1}{D015}{SCI-MAP}{Re-estimating any coefficient shall create a new realized product state and shall not silently modify an earlier transformed signal or parent.}
\PTCRequirement{056}{Empirical statistic limit}{Rationale 6.2}{D015}{NOI}{An empirical residual statistic shall declare centering, coefficients, support, effective degrees of freedom, correlation treatment, and lifecycle and shall not be labeled unbiased variance or precision without proof.}
\PTCRequirement{057}{Uncertainty taxonomy}{Rationale 6.2}{D014,D015}{SCI-CAL,NOI}{Formal covariance, marginal variance, empirical scatter, calibration/systematic uncertainty, response uncertainty, selection uncertainty, and cross-coordinate covariance shall be distinct typed states.}
\PTCRequirement{058}{Conditional covariance}{Rationale }{D014}{NOI}{A covariance propagated through $J_{\Theta}[Y]$, the derivative or linear part of the exact frozen application map, shall be labeled conditional on the exact resolved selected model and shall identify axes, units, normalization, support, rank, approximation, and omitted correlations.}
\PTCRequirement{059}{Selection uncertainty}{Rationale 6.2}{D012,D014}{NOI}{When fitted modes, grouping, rank, masks, classification, or coefficients vary, omission of the between-selection term in Equation~\ref{eq:total-covariance} shall be declared; unknown selection uncertainty shall not be zero.}
\PTCRequirement{060}{Cross-observation covariance}{Rationale 6.2}{D014}{SCI-CAL,NOI}{An absent cross-observation covariance block shall mean unknown/unavailable, not independence; shared calibration, atmosphere, model, APT, or processing state shall remain possible correlation causes.}

\subsection{Response and transfer}

\PTCRequirement{061}{Admitted upstream response}{Rationale 7.1}{D003,D013}{SCI-RTC,SCI-CAL}{A complete chain response shall begin from $K_{\rm up\to CAL}$, the complete admitted upstream response carried by the CAL product, with explicit source domain and CAL detector-time codomain. It shall compose every applicable admitted source-to-detector relation, beam convention, coordinate and scan geometry, RTC operation, and CAL operation, or the affected complete-response claim shall be unavailable. A supplied companion already on the CAL grid shall instead enter the PTC-local operator directly.}
\PTCRequirement{062}{Fixed-state companion}{Rationale 7.1}{D013,Q002}{SCI-RTC,SCI-CAL}{A fixed-state companion shall be acted on by $J_{\Theta}[Y]$, the derivative or linear part of the exact frozen application map, with the same groups, coordinates, metrics, supports, masks, rank, subspace, detector classes, boundaries, and fallbacks. It shall not enter or alter learning, and $K_{\rm up\to CAL}$ shall not be applied to a CAL-grid companion a second time.}
\PTCRequirement{063}{Full-procedure response}{Rationale }{D013}{None}{A full-procedure response shall rerun complete PTC fitting, selection, rank, classification, refinement, and application from the immutable admitted CAL parent under a declared perturbation. Its numerical finite difference shall use only the transformed-signal projection $\mathcal P_Z$; changed discrete or mixed state shall be retained separately through $\Delta_{\rm state}$.}
\PTCRequirement{064}{Response family}{Rationale 7.2}{D013}{None}{Where response depends materially on amplitude, perturbation side, location, source state, mask, rank, classification, or convergence, PTC shall publish a bounded response family or mark a stronger response unavailable.}
\PTCRequirement{065}{Package response boundary}{Rationale 7.2}{D013}{SCI-RTC,SCI-CAL}{A whole-chain RTC-to-CAL-to-PTC injection shall be a separately named cross-package study and shall not be relabeled PTC-only full-procedure response.}
\PTCRequirement{066}{Response status}{Rationale }{D013,D016}{None}{Every requested response role shall use exactly one availability status among computed/published, not computed or not requested for this product, invalid, and unavailable, with cause and validity domain. Response availability shall remain distinct from product realization state.}
\PTCRequirement{067}{Map-center diagnostic}{Rationale }{D016}{SCI-MAP,BEAM}{The optional estimated map-center point-source response shall require an exact source companion and parent domain, explicit fixed-state or full-procedure response role, complete propagated PTC companion, exact named reference MAP operator, center selector, band/mode/state binding, and uncertainty status.}
\PTCRequirement{068}{No response overclaim}{Rationale 7.3}{D002,D016}{SCI-MAP,BEAM}{A map-center or compact-source response shall not establish general PTC, off-center, spatially varying, extended-source, arbitrary-morphology, cross-band, cross-mode, beam-shape, or MAP authority.}

\subsection{Outputs, provenance, and boundaries}

\PTCRequirement{069}{Transformed intermediate}{Rationale 8.1}{D005}{SCI-MAP}{The in-memory transformed TOD shall be the authoritative PTC-to-MAP intermediate on the PTC-dependent route and shall not be labeled an independent sky estimator.}
\PTCRequirement{070}{Persisted role}{Rationale 8.1}{D005}{None}{A persisted PTC TOD shall declare either diagnostic artifact or requested derived analysis product; persistence shall not grant archival, map, beam, significance, or production authority.}
\PTCRequirement{071}{Material provenance}{Rationale }{D005}{None}{All material state affecting a declared consumer shall be linked to immutable parent, requested, effective-policy, observation-resolved, learned/fitted evidence, resolved selected model, applied/realized, and published states, plus supports, groups, modes, rank, coefficients, classification, response, covariance, randomness, and output identity.}
\PTCRequirement{072}{Atomic required outputs}{Rationale 8.1}{D005}{None}{A required product shall be complete only after all required components and links are durable. Partial publication or required-output failure shall propagate and shall not be labeled complete.}
\PTCRequirement{073}{Typed fallback}{Rationale 8.2}{D003,D007}{None}{Every fallback shall declare cause, stage, changed estimator/state, response effect, covariance effect, and affected availability; an unavailable support shall not become valid zero output.}
\PTCRequirement{074}{Insufficient support}{Rationale 8.2}{D007,D012}{None}{Empty, non-finite, zero-denominator, rank-deficient-beyond-policy, or otherwise insufficient support shall yield a declared unavailable/rejected state or an explicitly authorized typed fallback.}
\PTCRequirement{075}{Random state}{Rationale 8.2}{D006}{None}{Randomness capable of changing science output shall record generator family/version, seed, stream partition, draw identity, and input identity; repeated declared state shall be reproducible.}
\PTCRequirement{076}{Disabled PTC route}{Rationale }{D005}{SCI-MAP}{When PTC is disabled, named PTC products on the PTC-dependent route shall have product realization state \texttt{disabled}; no PTC centering, subtraction, coefficient, transformed product, or PTC-route MAP product shall be realized. Response availability shall be recorded on its separate axis and shall not be encoded as product nonexistence.}
\PTCRequirement{077}{Direct CAL-to-MAP separation}{Rationale 8.3}{D005}{SCI-MAP}{No requirement in this contract shall prohibit or authorize a separately governed direct CAL-to-MAP route.}
\PTCRequirement{078}{Excluded signal roles}{Rationale 8.3}{D002,D008}{SCI-RTC,BEAM}{Base v0.1 shall not authorize raw-$\Delta f/f$ Beammap PTC, raw-$r$ numerical science, $r$-derived subtraction from $x$, unconstrained joint $x/r$ PCA, cross-array fitting, or polarimetry.}
\PTCRequirement{079}{Ownership preservation}{Rationale 8.3}{D004,D005}{Adjacent packages}{Consuming another package's product shall not transfer ownership of RTC temporal conditioning, CAL calibration/atmosphere, AST/ALIGN coordinates, VAL eligibility, MAP estimation, NOI uncertainty, BEAM interpretation, FLT filtering, or FRUIT recurrence.}
\PTCRequirement{080}{Evidence-layer separation}{Rationale 9.2}{D006}{None}{The contract shall distinguish algebraic contract correctness, implementation conformity, representation/response fidelity, observational performance, and production readiness. This document shall claim only the first.}

\subsection{Explicit scientific-review scope-completion obligations}

\PTCRequirement{081}{External source/residual parent}{Rationale }{D004,D014}{AST,FRUIT}{Any source model, mask, residual, or prior-pass parent consumed for protection or fitting shall declare owner, product and recurrence identity, unit, coordinate frame, registration, validity, response, use-specific support, boundary rule, and relation to the immutable CAL parent. Missing required identity shall make the affected protected or fitted role unavailable.}
\PTCRequirement{082}{Shifted/null surrogate}{Rationale }{D006,D007}{VAL,NOI}{A shifted or null surrogate shall transform signal and its associated validity/eligibility, support, boundaries, randomness, and parent identity together under one declared rule. Insufficient transformed support shall be unavailable or rejected and shall not become a valid numerical-zero surrogate.}
\PTCRequirement{083}{Exact frozen application map}{Rationale }{D010,Q002}{None}{Every realized estimator shall publish $\mathcal A_{\Theta}$ and $J_{\Theta}[Y]$ with exact input/output domains, left/right/vectorized action, frozen quantities, recomputed coefficients, metric, supports, affine reference, and failure behavior. Equality to $Y-\widehat U$ on the fitted parent shall not substitute for this application contract.}
\PTCRequirement{084}{Candidate evidence retention}{Rationale }{D012}{Owner policy}{The learned/fitted evidence state shall retain every evaluated candidate, its fitted state, diagnostics, every predicate value and pass/fail cause, ordering and tie result, selected or rejected disposition, and the exact immutable application map of the selected model.}
\PTCRequirement{085}{Typed astronomical-transfer predicate}{Rationale }{D012,D013}{Owner policy}{Every astronomical-transfer predicate shall identify source class and companion, conditional or full-procedure response type, amplitude and location domain, metric, tolerance, mask/support, upstream response identity, response-uncertainty treatment, and the exact claim tested.}
\PTCRequirement{086}{Expectation and bias statement}{Rationale }{D010,D014}{NOI}{Each estimator family and product role shall state its conditional expectation or bias claim for astronomical signal, fitted nuisance, remaining detector noise, calibration uncertainty, and data-dependent selection, or mark each unsupported claim unavailable. No estimator shall be labeled unbiased by omission.}
\PTCRequirement{087}{Response-domain chain}{Rationale 7.1}{D013}{SCI-CAL}{Every response product shall distinguish the PTC-local operator $J_{\Theta}[Y]$, complete chain response $J_{\Theta}[Y]\circ K_{\rm up\to CAL}$, and realized propagated companion. Source-domain and CAL-grid parents shall have explicit domains, the response carried by the CAL product shall not be confused with only the CAL-owned multiplier, and each upstream operator shall be applied exactly once.}
\PTCRequirement{088}{Independent state axes}{Rationale }{D005,D013}{None}{Product realization, response availability, covariance availability, and validation/evidence disposition shall be separate typed axes. A disabled or not-requested product shall not be encoded as an invalid response, and an unavailable response shall not imply that an otherwise supported signal product does not exist.}

\PTCRequirement{089}{Fit-excluded application availability}{Rationale 4.2}{D007,D010}{None}{A fit-excluded occurrence shall be application-available only when the resolved frozen operator defines its value from admitted fitted state and support and every required basis coefficient or coefficient-recomputation input, neighboring support, detector binding, metric term, coordinate transform, and boundary state is available. Otherwise application at that occurrence shall be unavailable; it shall not be implicitly interpolated, zero-filled, reconstructed, or extended from the fit population.}
